decision: Playwright is evidence, not the template
reason: page.$ returns the one element as an ElementHandle, and strict mode fails it on several matches; Strider's locators return values and have no handle of an element, and page.evaluateHandle takes no selector

page.waitForSelector in strict mode fails at once on several matches. Strider has no waitForSelector, and the expectation that replaces it (Expect.toBeVisible) retries several matches until the deadline

A toBeVisible expectation on several matches fails at once with Playwright's strict mode error, which also renders each match's escaped tag name in a suggested locator. Strider's expectations retry several matches until the deadline, and fail with their match count there
